mainband_waveform.signaling: single-ended NRZ, unencoded, per data lane.
mainband_waveform.framing: Per module: N data lanes (16 Std / 64 Adv) + 1 Valid lane (qualifies data) + 1 forwarded Track/clock lane (strobe).
mainband_waveform.clocking: Source-synchronous: receiver samples data against the forwarded Track/clock; NOT clock-data-recovery.
mainband_waveform.note: No 8b/10b or 128b/130b line code; integrity is at the Flit/CRC level.

flit_waveform.flit_64B: 2-byte Flit Header + 60-byte payload + 2-byte (16-bit) CRC = 64 bytes; the Adapter inserts header at the start and CRC at the end of each Flit.
flit_waveform.all_zeros_idle: When the Protocol Layer has no Flit, the Adapter may send all-zero payload Flits to keep the link framed.

sideband_waveform.carries: data + clock; training, debug, management, register access.

link_state_transition_trigger_waveform.RESET_to_SBINIT: Reset deasserted; bring up the always-on sideband first.
link_state_transition_trigger_waveform.SBINIT_to_MBINIT: Sideband trained; begin mainband detect/repair and clock/Valid setup.
link_state_transition_trigger_waveform.MBINIT_to_MBTRAIN: Mainband lanes detected/repaired; per-lane training begins.
link_state_transition_trigger_waveform.MBTRAIN_to_LINKINIT: Per-lane timing/voltage calibrated at the negotiated data rate; data rate stepped up toward the advertised maximum.
link_state_transition_trigger_waveform.LINKINIT_to_ACTIVE: D2D Adapter parameter negotiation (rate/width/protocol/Flit format/Raw-vs-Flit) complete; Flits flow.
link_state_transition_trigger_waveform.ACTIVE_to_L1: Low-power entry (fast: 0.5 ns <=16G, 0.5-1 ns >=24G); link state preserved.
link_state_transition_trigger_waveform.ACTIVE_to_TRAINERROR: Persistent CRC/Retry failure or lane fault; invoke Lane Repair / width degradation and re-train.

lane_repair_waveform.advanced: Spare data lanes are available; a failing lane is remapped to a spare with no width loss.
lane_repair_waveform.standard: No spare lanes; the link degrades to a reduced width.
lane_repair_waveform.lane_reversal: Transmit-side lane reversal supported for routing flexibility.

general_timing_rule: UCIe mainband is source-synchronous at the per-module forwarded clock; the unit interval is set by the negotiated data rate (e.g. 31.25 ps UI at 32 GT/s, 62.5 ps at 16 GT/s). The Adapter's Flit framing, CRC, Retry, and link-state FSM are clocked at the internal die clock, decoupled from the per-lane UI. The sideband runs at a fixed 800 MHz regardless of mainband rate.

voltage_levels.modulation: NRZ single-ended; short on-package channel needs no equalization line code.
voltage_levels.termination: On-package controlled-impedance microbump/interposer routing (Advanced) or organic substrate (Standard).

data_rate_waveform.encoding: unencoded mainband; 16-bit Flit CRC at the Adapter
